statements.subject: client
statements.description: Patch version numbers SHOULD NOT be used in requests, responses and Agent Cards, and MUST not be considered when clients and servers negotiate protocol versions.
statements.post_cond: request.version_format = Major.Minor & response.version_format = Major.Minor & agent_card.version_format = Major.Minor
actions: Omit patch version numbers from requests
Omit patch version numbers from responses
Omit patch version numbers from Agent Cards

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Patch version numbers SHOULD NOT be used in requests, responses and Agent Cards, and MUST not be considered when clients and servers negotiate protocol versions.
actions: Ignore patch version numbers when clients and servers negotiate protocol versions

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MUST send the A2A-Version header with each request to maintain compatibility after an agent upgrades to a new version of the protocol (except for 0.3 Clients - 0.3 will be assumed for empty header).
actions: Include A2A-Version header in each request sent to the agent

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MAY provide the A2A-Version as a request parameter instead of a header.
actions: Include A2A-Version as a query/request parameter instead of an HTTP header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents MUST process requests using the semantics of the requested A2A-Version (matching Major.Minor).
actions: Process the request using the semantics of the A2A-Version specified in the request, matching Major.Minor

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the version is not supported by the interface, agents MUST return a VersionNotSupportedError.
actions: Return a VersionNotSupportedError response to the client

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents MUST interpret empty value as 0.3 version.
actions: Interpret an empty A2A-Version header value as protocol version 0.3

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Tooling libraries and SDKs that implement the A2A protocol MUST provide mechanisms to help clients manage protocol versioning, such as negotiation of the transport and protocol version used.
actions: Provide mechanisms to help clients manage protocol versioning
Support negotiation of the transport and protocol version used

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Client Agents that require the latest features of the protocol should be configured to request specific versions and avoid automatic fallback to older versions, to prevent silently losing functionality.
actions: Configure client to request specific protocol versions
Disable automatic fallback to older protocol versions
